cohort: The study included 500 participants in Sweden who completed an online survey.
finding: Self-reported negative capability changes outweighed positive changes, particularly in financial situation, political resources, and health, and were associated with lower incomes, living in smaller municipalities, being born outside Europe, living in the south of Sweden, and renting housing.
cross-section timing: June 2020 (assessing changes during the first half of 2020)
